2. Prescribed Medications & Clinical Plan
Based on the clinical findings (HbA1c: 8.2%, PPBS: 240 mg/dL), the patient requires a structured
pharmacological intervention to enhance insulin sensitivity and manage post-meal spikes:
 Metformin Hydrochloride (SR) - 500mg: 1 tablet after dinner. Acts by suppressing hepatic glucose
production.
 Glimepiride - 1mg: 1 tablet before breakfast. Stimulates beta cells of the pancreas to release insulin.
 Voglibose - 0.2mg: 1 tablet just before lunch. Delays carbohydrate absorption to reduce post-meal spikes.
3. 1500-Calorie Structured Diet Plan
To counteract hyperglycemia, a low-glycemic, fiber-rich nutritional regimen is advised:
 Early Morning (06:00 AM): 1 glass of fenugreek-infused water or sugar-free green tea + 5 soaked almonds.
 Breakfast (08:30 AM - ~350 kcal): 2 Millet Idlis or Jowar Rotis served with mint chutney + 1 boiled egg white.
 Lunch (01:00 PM - ~500 kcal): 1 small bowl of brown rice or Foxtail Millet rice + 1 large bowl of leafy green
vegetables/dal + 1 cup low-fat curd + fresh cucumber & carrot salad.
 Evening Snack (05:00 PM - ~150 kcal): 1 cup roasted chana or boiled sprouts + sugar-free tea.
 Dinner (08:00 PM - ~450 kcal): 2 whole-wheat pulkas + 1 cup mixed vegetable curry or grilled lean protein
(chicken/fish).

4. Physical Exercise & Management Protocol
Physical activity helps muscles utilize blood glucose directly, bypassing insulin resistance:
 Aerobic Exercise: 30 minutes of brisk walking, 5 days a week (Total 150 minutes/week).
